[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 14.1.2 (MUST) every presentation bound to the nonce of its own request
• 5.2 (MUST) a fresh nonce for every request
[SPEC] OpenID4VP 1.0 has no static request , so the printed QR carries a fixed request_uri and every read of it returns a new request object (new nonce and state)
[ENGINE RULE] one proof request = one link , used by one holder once
a second holder on the same link is refused (400 invalid_request) and the proof stays ACCEPTED , so the engine link cannot be printed
proof requests from the same proof schema and verifier DID have the same client_id and response_uri , nonce and state are new each time
0. Counter setup (once per counter , no proof request yet)
[SPEC] Verification template , verifier identity , ETDA Trusted List cache and the verifier check are the same as VP part 0 (verifier setup)
[SPEC] Trusted List not usable (TRUST_LIST_EXPIRED / TRUST_LIST_UNAVAILABLE) : the calling step answers 503 Service Unavailable + Retry-After: 300
not the trust failure reason of that step , as in the ETDA Trusted List Load sequence
Register a counter
verification template , verifier identity , purpose , counter name
Create counter QR + Consumer-Key + Token | POST /api/verification-counter/v1 (VCVP Core 41)
verification_template_id , verifier_identity_id , purpose (code , legal_basis) , counter_name
Check Consumer-Key and Token , validate caller authorization , otherwise 401 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED / 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Check Purpose.Code is in the Purpose.Code list , otherwise 400 FailureReason = REQUEST_REJECTED
[SPEC] not found 403 FailureReason = TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND / VERIFIER_DID_NOT_FOUND , another organisation 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
verifier not trusted 403 FailureReason = VERIFIER_NOT_TRUSTED (as VCVP Core 24)
Resolve the verification template (VerificationTemplates) and the verifier identity (VerifierIdentityId) of the caller organisation
Look up the verifier in the cached Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt , ETDA Trusted List Load) : service type = verifier (ServiceTypeIdentifier) , DID and key listed , status = active , purpose allowed
[ENGINE RULE] client_id = decentralized_identifier:{verifier DID} is known before any proof request exists
and equals the client_id of every request object the engine signs later for this verifier DID
[SPEC] openid4vp://?client_id=decentralized_identifier:{verifier DID}
&request_uri=https://{VCVP domain}/ssi/verification-counter/v1/{counter_id}/request-object
Build the counter QR (no engine call)
[DATA STORE] Store VerificationCounters table
CounterId , OrganizationId , VerificationTemplateId , VerifierIdentityId , Purpose , LegalBasis , CounterName , Status = ACTIVE
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 41 : who created which counter
(CounterId , VerificationTemplateId , VerifierIdentityId , Purpose , LegalBasis , TrustCheck)
200 | counter_id , counter_qr_url
Print the QR and place it at the counter
1. Holder scans the printed QR , DW Core reads the counter URL , VCVP Core creates a new verification request for this scan
[STANDARD] OpenID4VCI 1.0
• 13.4 (MUST NOT) sensitive elements not routed through a server component that is not fully trusted
[SPEC] DW Core is the server component of the wallet and is declared a fully trusted part of it (VCVP design decision)
the app calls only DW Core , DW Core makes every protocol call , the app signs and encrypts , DW Core checks the verifier (TC-1) for the wallet
[SPEC] Protocol endpoints (/ssi) carry no Consumer-Key
the request object read writes VCVPAuditLog (Actor Channel = WALLET , no caller OrgCode)
Scan the counter QR
Start verification + Token | POST /dw/v1/presentation/start (DW endpoint 12)
(QR content)
[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 5.1 (MUST) no request_uri_method , GET as in RFC 9101
Validate Token → CitizenId
Parse openid4vp:// → client_id , request_uri
Read request object from request_uri | GET /ssi/verification-counter/v1/{counter_id}/request-object (VCVP Core 42)
[SPEC] limit scans per counter (VCVP policy)
Read VerificationCounters table by CounterId (template , verifier identity , purpose) , Status = ACTIVE
Verifier still listed as a verifier service (ServiceTypeIdentifier) and active in the cached Verifier Trusted List (ver.txt , ETDA Trusted List Load)

[Counter not found or inactive , verifier not trusted or scan limit reached]
[ERROR AUDIT] Write audit record of VCVP Core 42 (FailureReason)

Cannot verify at this counter
[Counter active]
Create verification request | POST /api/proof-request/v1
proofSchemaId , protocol , transport , verifier , verifierKey
{ id } = VerificationId (state CREATED)
[STANDARD] PDPA B.E. 2562
• section 39 record of processing activities , including the purpose
[SPEC] purpose and legal basis are recorded when the request is created and cannot be added later
[DATA STORE] Store Verifications table
VerificationId = id from the engine , CounterId , Purpose , LegalBasis , Status = PENDING
Generate verification link | POST /api/proof-request/v1/{id}/share
body { "params" : { "clientIdScheme" : "decentralized_identifier" } }
url , state
Read request object | GET /ssi/openid4vp/final-1.0/{id}/client-request
1.1 Verifier signs the request object (signing point 1)
Sign request object (JWS ES256) with the verifier key
Signature
Request object JWT
client_id , nonce , state , response_uri , dcql_query
[ENGINE RULE] state in the request object is not the proof request id and the engine API does not return it
the wallet sees only the counter URL , so state is the key both sides know for this scan
[DATA STORE] Store state and nonce of the request object in Verifications table
OfferUrl + ExpiresAt , Status = PENDING
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 42 : a new verification request for this scan
(CounterId , Purpose , LegalBasis , TrustCheck , EngineCalls , Correlation.VerificationId)
Request object (signed JWT)
Fetch the verifier DID document and the Verifier Trusted List (same as VP part 2 , section 1)
TC-1 as in VP part 2 , section 1.2 (DW Core checks the verifier for the wallet)
not passed : verifierTrust = NOT_TRUSTED and the flow stops as in that section
200 (response of /dw/v1/presentation/start) | verifierTrust , client_id , state , nonce , response_uri ,
client_metadata.jwks + encrypted_response_enc_values_supported , dcql_query
[ENGINE RULE] three holders scanning the same printed QR at the same time got three proof requests
each was ACCEPTED with its own claim values , a later scan by the same holder made a fourth one
a scan that is never answered stays PENDING until the link expires (1 hour) then becomes INTERACTION_EXPIRED (tested on engine v1.88.1)

Same as VP part 2 , sections 2 to 8 , for this request
starts after the 200 of /dw/v1/presentation/start above , ends when VCVP Core 29 answers DW Core with 200
(/dw/v1/presentation/info , consent , VP signed on the device , /dw/v1/presentation/submit , TC-2 , TC-3 , engine verification)
DW Core and VCVP Core find this request by state , as in VP part 2
2. Holder gets a counter code in the response of /dw/v1/presentation/submit (pairs the result with the person at the counter)
[STANDARD] OpenID4VP 1.0
• 14.2 (SHOULD) cross-device flows add other mitigations against session fixation (the Response Code does not protect them)
[SPEC] with one printed QR the officer cannot tell which result belongs to the person in front of the counter , the code pairs them
The request came from a counter QR , DW Core gets the code before it answers /dw/v1/presentation/submit
Get counter code | GET /api/verification-counter/v1/counter-code/{state} (VCVP Core 43)
Check Consumer-Key (DW Core central Consumer-Key) , otherwise 401 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED / 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Find Verifications table by state → VerificationId , CounterId , not found 403 FailureReason = VERIFICATION_NOT_FOUND
Get proof request | GET /api/proof-request/v1/{id}
state

[state = ACCEPTED and TC-3 passed]
Issue a 4 digit code unique among the open results of this counter , short validity
[DATA STORE] Store CounterCode and CounterCodeExpiresAt in Verifications table
[AUDIT LOG] Write audit record of VCVP Core 43 : a counter code was issued (CounterId , Correlation.VerificationId , CounterCode)
200 | counter_code
200 (response of /dw/v1/presentation/submit) | result , CounterCode
Show the code ex : 4821
[Not ACCEPTED]
200 | status (no code)
200 (response of /dw/v1/presentation/submit) | result , no code
Sharing not completed
[PENDING] waiting for a VCVP team decision | OpenID4VP 1.0
issue : a wallet that does not use DW Core cannot get the code , section 8.2 (OPTIONAL) lets the response endpoint return a redirect_uri (a page that could show the code) , engine support not tested
question : support other wallets through redirect_uri , or keep the counter QR for wallets that use DW Core
[SPEC] to be discussed , phase 2 work : in phase 1 the counter QR serves wallets that use DW Core only
3. Officer reads the result by the code
Tell the code 4821
Select or enter the code of this counter
Get counter result + Consumer-Key + Token | GET /api/verification-counter/v1/{counter_id}/result/{counter_code} (VCVP Core 44)
Check Consumer-Key and Token , the counter belongs to the caller organisation , otherwise 401 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHENTICATED / 403 FailureReason = CALLER_NOT_AUTHORIZED
Find Verifications table by CounterId + CounterCode (not expired) → VerificationId , not found 403 FailureReason = COUNTER_CODE_INVALID
